concept.title: Body, mind and spirit on a single path.
concept.text: Ser unidad is a practice that brings together the body, the breath and the mind. No demands, no goals, just the intention of being more present and getting to know yourself a little better.

items.title: Asana
items.subtitle: Meditation
items.text: The posture as a door to stillness. The body settles, the breath slows down and the mind finds somewhere to rest.

items.title: Infinity
items.subtitle: Iteration and improvement
items.text: Everything is practice. Coming back, again and again, without chasing perfection. Consistency makes the path.

items.title: Elevation
items.subtitle: Growth
items.text: Self-knowledge and continuous development. A kinder relationship with body and mind that spreads into the rest of life.

services.title: A practice for every moment.
services.text: Regular classes, workshops, gatherings in nature and one-to-one guidance. Every offering is beginner friendly.

items.title: Hatha Yoga and Integral Yoga
items.text: Take care of your body, mind and energy. Classes adapted to every body and condition, so you can move toward your goals at your own pace.

items.title: Meditation and Mindfulness
items.text: Learn to meditate from the very beginning or deepen your practice. Live guidance, recorded meditations, exercises and a group to share the experience.

items.title: Applied philosophy
items.text: Yoga philosophy, Yoga Sutras, Samkhya, Ayurveda, Buddhism and mantras. Ancient tools brought into everyday life.

items.title: Private classes
items.meta: Monday to Thursday · Ask for availability
items.text: A practice designed for you, around your goals and abilities. Ideal to get started, to recover or to go deeper.

items.title: Meditation in the forest
items.text: An invitation to stop the daily rhythm, connect with nature, silence and the gaze inward. Voluntary contribution.

items.title: Retreats and workshops
items.text: Retreats in nature, breathing and meditation workshops, kirtan and community gatherings. A space to step out of the usual rhythm.

about.title: Hi, I'm Sergio Montagner.
paragraphs: I teach Hatha Yoga, Integral Yoga, Mindfulness meditation and applied philosophy in Maldonado and Punta del Este. My path runs through schools in Uruguay, Argentina and India, and through a personal practice that keeps growing every day.

I believe in a practice without demands or goals: a space to listen to yourself a little more, to ask of yourself just enough, and to dare to look inside. Perfect classes are fine, but the ones that teach the most are usually the others.
